Max and Jack are preparing a report about the supermarket. Little by little, things began to change. The experience taught Jack more than any book could. For example, the hall holds two thousand people.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Jack thanked Max for the honest advice. The supermarket looked quieter than usual that evening. What's more, inventory drops before the long weekend.

Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. For example, the digital wallet app is fast.

The book store has become an important part of daily life. People around Jack often share different ideas about the supermarket. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Tomatoes grow well in sunny gardens.
Jack plans to study art harder this term. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Jack bought a pair of shoes online because it was much cheaper.
